name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Stand with barbell across upper back. Feet shoulder-width apart. Lower by bending knees and hips, keeping chest up. Descend until thighs parallel to floor. Drive through heels to return to start.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench, feet flat on floor. Grip bar slightly wider than shoulders. Lower bar to mid-chest with control. Press bar up until arms fully extended.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot. Bend and grip bar. Keep back straight, chest up. Drive through heels, extending hips and knees simultaneously. Lower with control.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with bar at shoulder height, hands just outside shoulders. Press bar overhead until arms locked. Lower with control to shoulders.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Bend at hips, back straight, knees slightly bent. Pull bar to lower chest, squeezing shoulder blades. Lower with control.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulders. Pull body up until chin over bar. Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells at chest level. Press dumbbells up until arms extended. Lower with control to chest level.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs. Hinge at hips, lowering dumbbells along legs. Keep back straight, slight knee bend. Return to start by driving hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height. Press dumbbells overhead until arms extended. Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and hand on bench. Hold dumbbell in other hand. Pull dumbbell to hip, squeezing back. Lower with control.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell vertically at chest. Squat down keeping chest up, elbows inside knees. Drive through heels to stand.

name: Dumbbell Lunges
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Step forward into lunge, lowering back knee toward floor. Push off front foot to return. Alternate legs.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie on incline bench (30-45°). Press dumbbells up from chest until arms extended. Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Flyes
instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells extended above chest, slight elbow bend. Lower dumbbells out to sides in arc. Bring back to start.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides. Raise dumbbells out to sides until parallel to floor. Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms forward. Curl dumbbells up toward shoulders. Lower with control.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing each other. Curl dumbbells up. Lower with control.

name: Tricep Dips
instructions: Support body on dip bars. Lower body by bending elbows until upper arms parallel to floor. Push back to start.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower behind head by bending elbows. Extend back to start.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set cable at face height. Pull rope toward face, separating hands. Squeeze shoulder blades. Return with control.

name: Cable Chest Flyes
instructions: Stand between cables set high. Pull cables down and together in front of chest. Return with control.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at lat pulldown machine. Pull bar down to upper chest, squeezing shoulder blades. Return with control.

name: Cable Row
instructions: Sit at cable row station. Pull handle to torso, squeezing shoulder blades. Return with control.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in leg press, feet on platform. Lower platform by bending knees. Press through heels to extend.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit in leg extension machine. Extend legs until straight. Lower with control.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lie on leg curl machine. Curl heels toward glutes. Lower with control.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on platform, heels hanging off edge. Raise up on toes. Lower with control.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in plank position. Lower body until chest near floor. Push back to start.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width. Lower into squat, keeping chest up. Drive through heels to stand.

name: Bodyweight Lunge
instructions: Step forward into lunge, lowering back knee. Push off front foot to return. Alternate legs.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold body in straight line on forearms and toes. Keep core tight. Hold for time.

name: Crunches
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent. Curl shoulders toward pelvis. Lower with control.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet off floor. Rotate torso side to side. Keep core engaged.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Start in plank. Drive knees toward chest alternately in running motion. Keep core tight.

name: Burpee
instructions: From standing, drop to push-up position. Perform push-up. Jump feet to hands. Jump up with arms overhead.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place back foot on bench. Lower into lunge with front leg. Drive through front heel to stand.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Lean upper back on bench, barbell across hips. Drive hips up until body in line. Lower with control.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Hold barbell across front of shoulders. Squat down keeping chest up, elbows high. Drive through heels to stand.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Wide stance, toes out. Grip bar between legs. Keep chest up, drive through heels to lift. Lower with control.

name: Incline Barbell Press
instructions: Lie on incline bench. Lower bar to upper chest. Press up until arms extended.

name: Decline Barbell Press
instructions: Lie on decline bench. Lower bar to lower chest. Press up until arms extended.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar shoulder-width or narrower. Lower to chest. Press up, keeping elbows tucked.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle T-bar, bent over. Pull bar to chest, squeezing back. Lower with control.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from bar with underhand grip. Pull up until chin over bar. Lower with control.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: On dip bars, lean forward. Lower body until stretch in chest. Push back to start.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with dumbbells at shoulders, palms facing you. Press up while rotating palms out. Reverse motion down.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise dumbbells forward to shoulder height. Lower with control.

name: Rear Delt Flyes
instructions: Bend forward at hips. Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeezing shoulder blades. Lower with control.

name: Shrugs
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Raise shoulders toward ears. Lower with control.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest arms on preacher bench. Curl bar toward shoulders. Lower with control.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit, rest elbow on inner thigh. Curl dumbbell toward shoulder. Lower with control.

name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at cable machine, grip bar. Push bar down until arms extended. Return with control.

name: Skull Crushers
instructions: Lie on bench, bar extended above. Lower bar toward forehead by bending elbows. Extend back to start.

name: Kickback
instructions: Bend forward, upper arm parallel to floor. Extend forearm back. Return with control.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest forearms on bench, wrists hanging over edge. Curl wrists up. Lower with control.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest forearms on bench, palms down. Curl wrists up. Lower with control.

name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at sides. Walk forward with good posture. Maintain grip.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Bar across upper back. Hinge at hips, lowering torso. Keep back straight. Return to start.

name: Hyperextension
instructions: Position on hyperextension bench. Lower torso toward floor. Raise back to parallel.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel at cable machine, rope at head height. Crunch down, bringing elbows toward knees. Return with control.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar. Raise legs toward chest, keeping them straight. Lower with control.

name: Bicycle Crunches
instructions: Lie on back, hands behind head. Bring opposite elbow to knee in cycling motion. Alternate sides.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on side, support on forearm. Raise hips, body in straight line. Hold for time. Switch sides.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Stand side-on to cable at chest height. Press cable straight out, resist rotation. Return with control.

name: Landmine Rotation
instructions: Hold barbell end at chest. Rotate torso side to side, pivoting on feet. Control the movement.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand before box. Jump onto box with both feet. Step down. Repeat.

name: Jump Squat
instructions: Squat down. Explode up into jump. Land softly, absorbing impact. Repeat.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Place one foot on box. Step up, driving through heel. Step down with control. Alternate legs.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat. Drive hips up, squeezing glutes. Lower with control.

name: Single-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg, hold dumbbell. Hinge at hip, lowering dumbbell. Keep back straight. Return to start. Switch legs.

name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Attach ankle strap to cable. Kick leg back, squeezing glute. Return with control. Switch legs.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Step forward into lunge. Push off, bring back leg forward into next lunge. Continue walking.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Position in hack squat machine. Lower by bending knees. Drive through heels to extend.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand, lean back, knees forward. Lower body by bending knees. Rise back to start.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel, ankles secured. Lower torso forward with control, resisting with hamstrings. Push back to start.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Bend at hips, support on machine. Rise up on toes. Lower with control.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit in machine, knees under pads. Rise up on toes. Lower with control.

name: Pec Deck Machine
instructions: Sit at pec deck, arms on pads. Bring pads together in front of chest. Return with control.

name: Chest Press Machine
instructions: Sit at chest press machine. Push handles forward until arms extended. Return with control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
instructions: Lie on incline bench. Lower dumbbells out to sides in arc. Bring back to start.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand between cable stacks set high. Pull cables down and together. Return with control.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from bar with wide overhand grip. Pull up until chin over bar. Lower with control.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Bend at hips, bar on floor. Pull bar explosively to chest. Lower to floor between reps.

name: Meadows Row
instructions: Stagger stance at landmine end. Pull bar to hip, rotating torso. Lower with control. Switch sides.

name: Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Lie face down on incline bench. Pull dumbbells to hips. Lower with control.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Hang under bar at waist height, body straight. Pull chest to bar. Lower with control.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Sit at row machine. Pull handles to torso. Return with control.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand at cable machine, bar high. Pull bar down to thighs, arms straight. Return with control.

name: Pullovers
instructions: Lie on bench, dumbbell overhead. Lower dumbbell back in arc. Pull back to start.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Hold bar at thighs. Pull bar up along body to chin. Lower with control.

name: Military Press
instructions: Stand with bar at shoulders. Press bar overhead. Lower with control.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit at shoulder press machine. Press handles overhead. Return with control.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand at cable machine, grip low. Raise arm out to side. Return with control. Switch arms.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Sit at reverse pec deck. Pull handles back, squeezing shoulder blades. Return with control.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold bar at thighs. Raise shoulders toward ears. Lower with control.

name: Cable Shrug
instructions: Stand at cable machine, grip low. Raise shoulders toward ears. Lower with control.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Hold EZ-bar at thighs. Curl bar toward shoulders. Lower with control.

name: Cable Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand at cable machine, grip low. Curl cable toward shoulders. Lower with control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit on incline bench, arms hanging. Curl dumbbells toward shoulders. Lower with control.

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Lie face down on incline bench. Curl bar toward shoulders. Lower with control.

name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand back to cable, rope overhead. Extend arms forward and up. Return with control.

name: Rope Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at cable, grip rope. Push down, separating rope ends. Return with control.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Hands on bench behind you, legs extended. Lower body by bending elbows. Push back to start.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Push-up position, hands forming diamond. Lower body. Push back to start.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel, grip ab wheel. Roll forward, extending body. Pull back to start.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on back, arms up, knees bent at 90°. Lower opposite arm and leg. Alternate sides.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: On hands and knees. Extend opposite arm and leg. Return. Alternate sides.

name: Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on back. Raise legs toward ceiling. Lower with control, not touching floor.

name: V-Up
instructions: Lie flat. Simultaneously raise torso and legs to form V. Lower with control.

name: Windshield Wiper
instructions: Hang from bar, raise legs to L. Rotate legs side to side. Control the movement.

name: Wood Chop
instructions: Stand at cable, grip high. Rotate and pull down across body. Return. Switch sides.

name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie holding kettlebell overhead. Stand up through series of movements. Reverse to lie down.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge at hips, swing kettlebell between legs. Drive hips forward, swing to chest height.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold kettlebell at chest. Squat down, elbows inside knees. Drive through heels to stand.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Swing kettlebell between legs. Pull explosively overhead in one motion. Lower with control.

name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Hold rope ends. Create waves by alternating or simultaneous arm movements.

name: Sled Push
instructions: Push sled forward, driving through legs. Maintain forward lean, core tight.

name: Sled Pull
instructions: Attach rope to sled. Walk backward, pulling sled toward you with arms or body.

name: Tire Flip
instructions: Squat, grip under tire. Drive through legs, push tire up and over.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
instructions: Hold medicine ball overhead. Slam forcefully to ground. Pick up and repeat.

name: Wall Ball
instructions: Hold medicine ball at chest. Squat down. Drive up, throwing ball to target on wall. Catch and repeat.

name: TRX Row
instructions: Hold TRX handles, lean back, body straight. Pull chest to handles. Lower with control.

name: TRX Push-Up
instructions: Feet in TRX straps, push-up position. Lower body. Push back to start.

name: TRX Pike
instructions: Feet in TRX, plank position. Pike hips up, forming inverted V. Lower with control.

name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold band at chest, arms extended. Pull band apart, squeezing shoulder blades. Return with control.

name: Resistance Band Squat
instructions: Stand on band, hold ends at shoulders. Squat down. Drive through heels to stand.

name: Resistance Band Chest Press
instructions: Anchor band behind, hold at chest. Press forward until arms extended. Return with control.

name: Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Kick into handstand against wall. Lower head toward floor. Press back to start.

name: Muscle-Up
instructions: Pull-up explosively. Transition over bar into dip position. Press to full extension.

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg, other extended forward. Squat down on standing leg. Drive back to start.

name: L-Sit
instructions: Support on parallel bars. Raise legs to L-position. Hold for time.

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on bench, grip behind head. Raise body, pivoting on shoulders. Lower with control.

name: Front Lever
instructions: Hang from bar. Raise body parallel to floor, face up. Hold for time.

name: Skin the Cat
instructions: Hang from bar. Raise knees, roll backward through arms. Return with control.

name: Zercher Squat
instructions: Hold bar in elbow crooks. Squat down. Drive through heels to stand.

name: Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Stand on platform, increasing range. Perform deadlift with extended range of motion.

name: Paused Bench Press
instructions: Lower bar to chest. Pause 1-2 seconds. Press explosively to lockout.

name: Tempo Squat
instructions: Squat with controlled tempo (3 sec down, 2 sec pause, explode up). Increases time under tension.

name: Pin Press
instructions: Set bar on pins at desired height. Press from pins to lockout. Reset between reps.

name: Floor Press
instructions: Lie on floor. Lower bar until elbows touch floor. Press to lockout.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Snatch
instructions: Swing dumbbell between legs. Pull explosively overhead. Lower and repeat. Switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulders. Squat down. Drive up, pressing dumbbells overhead.

name: Clean and Press
instructions: Deadlift bar, pull to shoulders (clean). Press overhead. Lower and repeat.

name: Power Clean
instructions: Deadlift bar explosively. Pull to shoulders, catching in quarter squat. Stand.

name: Hang Clean
instructions: Hold bar at thighs. Dip and explode, pulling bar to shoulders. Catch and stand.

name: Snatch Grip Deadlift
instructions: Wide grip on bar. Deadlift with extended range of motion.

name: Rack Pull
instructions: Set bar on pins at knee height. Deadlift from pins, focusing on lockout.

name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Wide stance, toes out. Hold dumbbell between legs. Squat down. Drive through heels to stand.

name: Cossack Squat
instructions: Wide stance. Shift weight to one side, squatting on that leg. Other leg straight. Alternate.

name: Seal Row
instructions: Lie face down on elevated bench. Pull bar to chest. Lower with control.

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Hold barbell end at shoulder. Press up at angle. Lower with control.

name: Landmine Row
instructions: Straddle landmine end. Pull bar to hip. Lower with control.

name: Z-Press
instructions: Sit on floor, legs extended. Press bar overhead from shoulders. Lower with control.

name: Bradford Press
instructions: Press bar just overhead. Lower behind head. Press up. Lower to front. Repeat.

name: Yates Row
instructions: Underhand grip, less bent over than standard row. Pull bar to lower abs. Lower with control.
